vulnerability.title: First Depositor Exchange Rate Inflation Bug (ERC4626 Antecedent)
vulnerability.rootCause: Division rounding down to zero when totalSupply == 0, allowing an attacker to donate underlying assets and inflate exchangeRateCurrent.
vulnerability.attackVector: Attacker mints 1 wei cToken, donates $50k USDC directly to contract, inflating exchange rate so subsequent victim deposits round to 0 shares.
